card.name: Words just before tumor or body terms
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'tumor' or a small linking word or punctuation mark in clinical text, where the next word is likely a noun such as burden, lysis, expansion or vessels. Several firing words are unrelated, so the pattern is loose.

modes.label: The word tumor
modes.description: Fires on 'tumor' when it is followed by a noun such as expansion, burden or lysis.
modes.example: if evidence of<< tumor>> expansion develops, discontinuation of bromoc

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Fires on short words or punctuation such as 'the', 'with', 'low' or a comma inside a clinical phrase.
modes.example: displacement of the uterus off<< the>> great vessels should be accomplished.

modes.label: Digits and endings
modes.description: Occasionally fires on a digit in a number or on the ending of a verb.

card.plain: It lights up on 'tumor' and on small linking words in clinical text, just before the next noun.
